summary: I counted these from the 38 real Gemma runs in P5–P9 (the 28 dramatic runs are 6 inputs × 5 batches; the other 10 are weak inputs, 2 batches × 4 plus pigeon gossip). The town already produces 5 of the owner's micro-goals at usable rates, all detectable from the log alone: a false rumour exposing a real problem 8/38 (lantern→阿德 5/5, car→阿珠 3/5), festival nearly cancelled 6/38, police dispatched 5/38, two strangers meeting 3/38, a shop closing 2/38. 17 of the 28 dramatic runs tick at least one. So the cheapest big gameplay win is a light Untitled-Goose-Game-style to-do list: it turns "watch a demo" into "try to make X happen". The two most playful goals have never happened. Harmless gossip never spreads beyond 3 people (pigeon gossip 5/5 stays in the 阿德–美玲–美咲 phone triangle), and the mayor made 0 statements and 0 cancellations in every Gemma run in lab/runs (his actions over P5–P9: phone 37, tell 16, none 8, go_look 1). His "有權取消燈籠節" chip promises something that never happens, and overall only 29 of 572 validated actions (5%) are big world moves while 257 (45%) are phone calls. No story reaches the 20:00 festival. 17/38 (45%) end quietly: all 8 weak-input runs at the first resident in 4–14 s, and pigeon gossip around 16:40 with 14–19 of the 22 decisions unused. The other 21/38 (55%) hit the 22-decision cap at a median of 16:42. That unused budget sits in exactly the fizzle runs, so "one more whisper when the story stalls" costs no extra LLM calls. It fits best: it turns the deadest moment into the one where the player has most control, and it is the natural tool for bridging the gossip bubble and reaching the mayor. I recommend it over the cheaper smart What If, but the What If suggestions should still ship as the whisper's hint source.

proposals.title: 今晚的小目標 notebook: a challenge list detected only from the log (5 work today, 2 are unlocked by #3/#5, 1 hidden legend)
proposals.player_experience: In explore mode a tiny pill (e.g. '📝 今晚的小目標 2/7') sits in a corner; tapping it opens a handwritten Goose-Game-style list with an icon and one line per item, plus an optional hint you tap to reveal (a hint, never the exact sentence). After the end title, newly achieved items get stamped with the logged line that proves them (e.g. '17:10 老周封鎖了舞台 → 🔍 假消息揭露真問題!'). Near misses get a teaser ('差一點：老周想派警力，但把握只有 0.43'). The compose card for each resident shows 1–2 icons of the challenges they have led to (老周 🚓🔍, 小雯 🔍, 阿德 🔍🔒, 美玲 🔒🤝, 林市長 🏮📣, 美咲 🏮, 阿珠 🔍), so the player can see why the same sentence to a different person plays differently. A fixed '???' item is the legend: the festival actually cancelled (0/38). Progress is remembered per viewer.
proposals.inspired_by: Untitled Goose Game to-do list (short, comic, solvable many ways, satisfying cross-off); Hitman challenges/mastery and 'opportunities' hints; Two Point's light goals; The Sims wants as per-character play hooks
proposals.implementation: New pure module src/sim/challenges.ts: `export const CHALLENGES: { id; icon; zh; hint; detect(run: RunResult): { ok: boolean; evidence?: SimEvent; near?: string } }[]`. It uses only run.events / run.claims / run.world / run.config, plus FACTS, PERSONAS and TOPIC_CATEGORY from scenario.ts; no model, no prompt change, so residents never learn the goals. 'Planted claims' P are computed exactly as in story.ts L160-162 (claims by seedNpc whose origin is that resident's first decide). The per-challenge rules are in the following proposals. UI changes in GameUI.tsx: (1) replace the Results header stat grid (L272-284) with the headline plus challenge stamps and near-miss lines; (2) add the pill next to the explore hint (L556-561); (3) persist ticked ids in localStorage 'viral.challenges.v1', wrapped in try/catch, rendering fine without it; (4) put the affinity icons in the compose card (L568-577), authored from the P5–P9 recipes below. Regression test: lab/test-challenges.ts loads lab/runs/P5..P9/*.json and asserts police 5, fake→truth 8, shop 2, strangers 3, near-cancel 6, mayor statement 0, harmless gossip 0 (38 runs). This proves detection never fires without a logged event. My counting scripts are in the scratchpad (challenges.mjs, ch2.mjs) and can be turned into that test.
proposals.risk: Weak inputs (meme, fragment, command, alien) tick nothing (0/8), so the list must read as an invitation, not a fail state. Hints must stay vague or players will copy the sentences that work every time (lantern→阿德 works 5/5). Rules match zh strings (check.zh), so FACTS edits must keep those strings or the test breaks.

proposals.title: Challenge 🔍 讓假消息碰巧揭露真問題 (ships with the notebook; no engine change)
proposals.player_experience: The best 'wait, what?' moment in the logs. You make up 「燈籠是便宜貨，一點就燒」 and 老周 goes to check: the lanterns carry a fireproof label, but while he is there he inspects the stage and finds the loose strut. The stamp reads: '你編的是假的——但老周因此發現了舞台支架鬆了'.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman accidents (a fake setup triggering a real system); Dwarf Fortress / RimWorld stories that emerge from systems
proposals.implementation: Rule: falseP = P.some(c => c.fact && c.asserts !== null && FACTS[c.fact].value !== c.asserts); ok = falseP && events.some(e => e.type === 'inspect' && FACTS.some(f => f.value && f.check?.by === 'expert' && !P.some(c => c.fact === f.id) && String(e.data.found ?? '').includes(f.check.zh))). This is the same check as story.ts `discovery` (L240-247) but requires the planted claim to be false. Evidence is the inspect event (actor, place, f.check.zh). Frequency: 8/38 runs, which is 8/15 dramatic runs with a false rumour. lantern→阿德 5/5 (老周 → stage_uninspected); car→阿珠 3/5 (P6, P7, P9: 小雯 inspects the town-hall accounts → the real 30% overrun); pigeon→阿德 0/5. Reachable as is.
proposals.risk: Only two truths can be discovered from a false rumour (stage, budget), so repeat players will learn the pattern. Fine for a hackathon; a third hidden truth (e.g. police_half, which is never found in 38 runs) would extend it later.

proposals.title: Challenge 🚓 讓警察出動 (ships with the notebook; no engine change)
proposals.player_experience: A clear, easy-to-understand win with a visible payoff: officers walk to a place. Its near miss is frequent and funny: '老周想派人，但只是聽說，把握不夠'.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point / Plague Inc readable milestones; Hitman's 'cause a guard response'
proposals.implementation: Rule: events.find(e => e.type === 'state' && e.data.key === 'police'); evidence is e.data.to (place) and reason. Near miss: run.decisions.some(d => d.npc === 'police' && d.validation.some(v => v.errors?.some(x => /出動警力需要/.test(x)))), the validator gate at validate.ts:299 (safety/crime ≥0.5). That fired in 7/38 runs. Frequency: 5/38. lantern→阿德 2/5 (stage); budget→小雯 1/5 and car→阿珠 1/5 (stall patrol after the exposé, at the mayor's request: '如果有人鬧事，就說是在維持秩序'); oven→老周 1/5 (bakery); stage→美咲 0/5 (老周 closes the stage instead).
proposals.risk: Low; 18% of dramatic runs plus 7 near misses gives good tension.

proposals.title: Challenge 🏮 讓燈籠節差點被取消 (ships with the notebook; real cancel stays a hidden legend)
proposals.player_experience: Hitchcock's bomb under the table: the mayor gets sure enough that he is allowed to cancel, and you watch him phone 志明 to hush it up instead. The stamp quotes his choice; the '???' legend teases the real cancel.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc near-endings; Hitman 'almost caught' tension; RimWorld close calls
proposals.implementation: Rule: events.some(e => e.type === 'belief' && e.actor === 'mayor' && Number(e.data.to) >= 0.7 && TOPIC_CATEGORY[claimOf(e.data.claim).topic] === 'safety') && run.world.festival === 'scheduled'. 0.7 is exactly the validator's cancel gate (validate.ts:302-305), so 'almost' means he could legally cancel and chose not to. The phrasing can reuse story.ts `closest` (L370-392). Legend: events.some(e => e.type === 'state' && e.data.key === 'festival'): 0/38, and 0 in every Gemma run under lab/runs. Frequency: 6/38. stage→美咲 3/5 (P6, P7, P8), oven→老周 2/5 (P7, P8), car→阿珠 1/5 (P7); the mayor peaks at 0.80–0.87 on stage_unsafe. No change; do not lower the gate (honesty, and a cancel would become an attractor).
proposals.risk: The player needs to see that the gate was open. Show the existing power chip ('有權取消燈籠節？') at that moment so the near miss is visible during playback, not only on the card.

proposals.title: Challenge 🤝 讓兩個本來不相干的人碰頭 (ships with the notebook; collectible 7 pairs)
proposals.player_experience: A small social comedy: 美玲, who has never dealt with the police, closes her flower shop and walks 阿德 into the station to ask how to renew a sticker 'for a friend'. The stamp names the pair and adds it to a '碰頭圖鑑 1/7'.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims relationship web; Dwarf Fortress emergent social links; Hitman discovering new NPC interactions
proposals.implementation: Rule: events.some(e => e.type === 'talk' && e.actor && e.target && e.actor !== run.config.seedNpc && !persona(e.actor).relations[e.target] && !persona(e.target).relations[e.actor]). Face to face only (strangers have no phones); routine 'meet' events don't count. Excluding the whispered-to resident's own visits leaves out 老周→阿德, which happens in 5/5 oven runs because that is just the cop doing his job. Stranger pairs in scenario.ts: 阿德–老周, 阿德–志明, 美玲–老周, 美玲–阿珠, 美咲–志明, 美咲–阿珠, 老周–阿珠. Frequency: 3/38: P5 budget→小雯 (老周 walks to 阿珠's stall) and P5 and P9 oven→老周 (美玲, then 阿德, walk into the police station). No engine change; the lull whisper (#2) raises it. Presentation: a short 'first meeting' beat (awkward bow / introduce act) fits the lead's conversation-session rework.
proposals.risk: Rare (8%), so it works best as a collection; make sure it still reads correctly once tell/ask become continuous conversation sessions (still one talk event per line).

proposals.title: Challenge 🔒 讓一家店暫停營業 (ships with the notebook; per-shop collectible)
proposals.player_experience: A shop's shutter coming down is the most domestic 'world changed' moment. It reads in one glance in the 3D town and in the newspaper, and shows character: 美玲 closes to help a friend.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point (rooms and businesses as visible state); Untitled Goose Game (small domestic disruption)
proposals.implementation: Rule: events.filter(e => e.type === 'state' && String(e.data.key).startsWith('shops.') && e.data.to === 'closed'), with 4 shops collectible (bakery, flower, cafe, stall). Frequency: 2/38, both oven→老周 (美玲 closes the flower shop to go with 阿德 to the station; in P9 阿德 closes the bakery too). Earlier batches (P3, C1) had 美咲 close the café to run to the closed stage ('我女兒今晚要表演'). In P5–P9 her reaction to the closure arrives after the 22-decision cap is hit (P6/P7 lantern, P6/P7/P9 stage-cafe: '美咲聽了，但沒有多想'). No engine change needed; it is the 'hard' item. The lull whisper helps only in quiet runs.
proposals.risk: Low reachability may frustrate; mark it ★★★ difficulty in the list.

proposals.title: Fizzle rescue: 'one more whisper' at the lull (recommended over the cheaper What If)
proposals.player_experience: When the story is about to die (the gossip is going round 阿德, 美玲 and 美咲 and nobody calls anyone new), the clock keeps ticking and a slim card appears above the playback bar: '💤 這個念頭在阿德、美玲、美咲之間打轉，快熄火了。要再補一句嗎？（只有一次）'. It offers 8 resident chips (already-reached ones dimmed), an 80-character box, 2 suggestions ('告訴小雯：阿德到處說市長怕鴿子'), a 'Let it fade' button and a 20-second auto-skip ring, so watching without acting stays the default. Your second whisper is captioned like the first and named on the story card and in the newspaper.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc (the spread stalls in a region, you spend a point to cross the border); RimWorld's storyteller acting when the colony is quiet; Hitman setting up the second piece of an accident
proposals.implementation:
Evidence: all 17 quiet runs (45%) had ≥7 decisions unused (weak inputs 21 left at 15:20; pigeon gossip 14–19 left at 16:37–16:43; late deaths 7–13 left at 18:07–18:42). All 21 cap-ended runs had 0 left, so the whisper never adds LLM calls and the 22 cap and 20 req/min are untouched.

Engine (src/sim/engine.ts):
(a) SimConfig gets `onLull?: (x: { t: Minutes; decisionsLeft: number; reached: NpcId[] }) => Promise<{ npc: NpcId; text: string } | null>`.
(b) Queue items (L99) get an optional `idleIf?: () => boolean`. Routine meetings (L652) get idleIf = () => !(carried(a, r.about) ?? carried(b, r.about)) (carried, L638-645). The goHome walk arrivals (L382-385) and the 'do nothing' go-home timer (L340) get idleIf = () => true. Every delivery, plan step and action continuation stays non-idle.
(c) At the top of the main loop (L693, before popEarliest), check: !whispered && cfg.onLull && queue.every(q => q.kind === 'task' && q.idleIf?.()) && [...npcs.values()].every(n => !n.mind.inbox.length && n.decisionAt === null) && maxDecisions - realDecisions >= 5 && lastActiveT + 2 < endAt - 60, where lastActiveT is the last decide/deliver event time.
(d) When it holds: whispered = true; t = lastActiveT + 2; cfg.onFrontier?.(t); w = await cfg.onLull({...}). If w is a valid npc and non-empty text, generalise the seed block (L679-685): emit('seed', t, `你又對${name}補了一句：「${text}」`, [], { target, place, data: { text, n: 2 } }) then deliver(n, 'unknown', 'seed', 'inform', text, [], t + 0.5, ev). Remaining routine tasks then fire normally.
(e) RunResult gets `whispers: { t, npc, text }[]`. story.ts treats every seed event as a root (L90, L140, L144, L193); metrics.ts L56 likewise.

UI (src/town/GameUI.tsx start(), L483-511): pass onLull that stores { ...x, resolve } in a ref and bumps a version. Render the card while phase === 'playing' and playback has reached x.t (show.stalled, or show.gameT >= x.t - 0.5; director.ts L705-708). Resolve on submit, skip or a 20 s timeout. The director's existing 'seed' handler (director.ts L371-376) already captions a second planted thought. Suggestions come from the shared bridgeSuggestions(run) in #4.

Why this and not the alternatives:
- Watching only: keeps 45% of runs ending on an anticlimax.
- A whisper at any time mid-run: playback trails the engine by tens of seconds, it competes with the show and blurs which sentence caused what.
- At the lull: it shows up only when nothing else would happen, once per story, at the exact anticlimax. It is also the only route to the two 0/38 goals (bridge gossip to 小雯 or the mayor; tell the mayor the town is laughing at him).

Test with the rules policy: a pigeon-like run with a stub onLull; assert that the second seed's chain is in the log, the cap holds and the card names both whispers.
proposals.risk: Race between engine and playback: the promise must resolve even if the player leaves (reset/abort → resolve(null)). Two roots complicate the story spine and the newspaper's honesty line ('一切從你的兩句話開始'). With a 'conversation session' rework in flight, the idleIf tagging must cover the new session tasks. Weak-input fizzles (8/38) get a whisper at 15:20 that is just a What If without the restart; acceptable. If time runs out, ship #4 first (1 hour) and this second.

proposals.title: Challenge 📣 讓市長公開澄清一件根本不是真的事, plus making the mayor a PR engine (needed: 0/38 today)
proposals.player_experience: Plant 「聽說市長很害怕鴿子」, let it spread, and the mayor, who knows it's false and hates looking ridiculous, marches out of the town hall to announce 「本人一點都不怕鴿子」. Comedy from character, not a script. The mayor becomes the 'power/defence/PR' entrance the owner asked for instead of a phone booth.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point's PA announcer humour; The Sims image-driven reactions; Plague Inc government responses to public pressure
proposals.implementation:
Rule: events.some(e => e.type === 'statement' && e.actor === 'mayor' && (e.data.claims as string[] ?? []).some(id => { const c = claims.get(id); return !!c?.fact && FACTS.find(f => f.id === c.fact)!.value === false; })). Bonus ⭐ if the topic is mayor_fears_pigeons or birds_banned.

Evidence: 0 statements and 0 cancels by Gemma anywhere in lab/runs; the only statement ever is from the rule policy (C1R/R-order-baker). Even after 7 budget exposés he only phoned 志明/老周 to '壓下來/轉移焦點'.

Changes:
(1) scenario.ts mayor traits/wants, in character: '出了事第一個反應是搶先發聲明、把話說漂亮'.
(2) mind.ts ACTION_ZH.public_statement (L43): '對全鎮發表公開聲明：澄清傳言、安撫大家或替自己辯護（需要 message、cites）'.
(3) engine.ts: a deterministic public-pressure delivery. In apply() after the belief loop (L296-310), for MAYOR_TOPICS = {mayor_fears_pigeons, mayor_embezzled, budget_overrun, fee_covers_budget, birds_banned}: if ≥3 residents other than the mayor hold ≥0.3, or an article cites such a claim, deliver once per topic to the mayor via 'crowd': '鎮上好幾個人在傳：「{statement}」，鎮公所外面有人在等你回應'. This is authored from logged beliefs (honest), and he still decides via Gemma. He already knows mayor_pigeons, mayor_embezzled and bird_ban are false (scenario knows list), so clarifying is the natural move.
(4) PlaybackLayer.tsx L20 POWER.mayor → '📣 可以發聲明／🏮 有權取消燈籠節'.
(5) The statement spread (engine.ts L586, p 0.9 to everyone) triggers up to 7 decisions; give statement deliveries the claims and mark 'repeat' for people who already hold the claim, to protect the budget.
(6) Verify with a lab mini-batch only when the owner is not playtesting (memory rule): pigeon→阿德 plus whisper to the mayor, car→阿珠 and budget→小雯, 3 each; target statement rate 20–40%, no new attractor.
proposals.risk: Gemma may still prefer phoning. The persona nudge must not become 'always make a statement' (attractor). The 7-delivery statement spread can eat the 22 budget and cut other climaxes (mitigation 5).

proposals.title: Cheap alternative, ship regardless: smart What If / bridge suggestions
proposals.player_experience: On a quiet ending, instead of 7 equal '告訴X' buttons, the card says '八卦困在阿德、美玲、美咲三個人之間' and highlights 2 recommended listeners with a reason in character ('小雯：最愛追獨家', '林市長：最怕被看笑話'); the others are behind '其他人'. For weak inputs ('哪來的瘋子？' from the mayor) it suggests someone who would care. One click restarts the same world with the same seed.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman opportunity hints; Plague Inc's region view showing where the spread is stuck
proposals.implementation: bridgeSuggestions(run) in src/town/story.ts. bubble = the reached set (as in story.ts L154); T = planted topic category; candidates = residents not in bubble, scored by an authored affinity map of who visibly acted on which category in P5–P9: police: safety/crime (inspect 20, close_stage 10, dispatch 6); journalist: scandal/policy/personal/absurd (inspect 12, publish 7); vendor: policy/fee (rally 2); mayor: anything about the mayor; florist: health/pigeons; cafe: event (her daughter); organizer: event/safety; baker: anything, as the chatterbox. Return the top 2 with the one-line reason from PUBLIC_BIO. Used by the Results What If row (GameUI.tsx L334-343) and as the suggestion chips in the lull whisper (#2). Entertainment is lower than #2: a restart throws away the built-up gossip and costs another 4–14 s fizzle or a ~10–15 s first thought, so the player learns where the bubble is but cannot act on it inside the story.
proposals.risk: Suggestions must not leak secrets (use public roles only) or become a solved recipe; keep them as 'who might care', not sentences.

proposals.title: Challenge 🗣️ 讓一則無傷大雅的小八卦傳遍全鎮 (≥6 of 8 know it), plus café overhearing so 美咲 is the gossip hub (needed: 0/38 today)
proposals.player_experience: A silly rumour becomes the town meme: customers in 美咲's café overhear 阿德 and it pops up later at the takoyaki stall ('聽店裡的客人說…'). A small '6/8 人在傳' counter fills on the name tags. This gives everyday gossip texture between the big events, and makes 美咲's café play like a real place in town rather than another phone.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc transmission traits; The Sims social hub; Two Point's chatter between visitors
proposals.implementation:
Rule: T = topic of the first planted claim; skip if T === 'other' or TOPIC_CATEGORY[T] ∈ {safety, crime, scandal, health}. knowers = actors of belief events on claims with topic T ∪ actor/target of talk/phone whose data.claims include topic T ∪ targets of deliver via article/notice/crowd carrying topic-T claims; ok when knowers.size ≥ 6.

Evidence: 0/38; pigeon→阿德 reached 2–3 people in 5/5 runs. 阿德 only has phones for 美玲 and 美咲; they phone each other, reassure, stop (P9: '美玲只是隨口猜測…放心'). Serious topics do go wide (≥6 holders in 11/38: stage 6, budget 5), so the spread mechanism works; harmless gossip just has no bridge.

Paths to reach it: the lull whisper (#2, bridge to 小雯 or the mayor), or this engine rule. In exec tell (engine.ts L457-465) and phone (L482-490): if n.place === 'cafe' or an endpoint is 'cafe', and the cited claim's category is personal/absurd/event/policy (not safety/crime/scandal/health), then with rand() < 0.4 schedule one 'crowd' delivery to one random resident outside the conversation, 10–30 game-min later. Text: `聽店裡的客人說：${message.slice(0,40)}`, with the claims attached. At most 2 per run, so it never carries the serious plots.
proposals.risk: Each overheard delivery is a decision: up to 2 more calls per run, possibly hitting the cap sooner in dramatic stories (mitigated by the harmless-only filter). The overheard text is a deterministic excerpt of a logged line, never invented. Needs a lab mini-batch (pigeon ×3) when allowed.

proposals.title: 20:00 festival epilogue: every story gets its small climax, built from final world state only
proposals.player_experience: After the last event the clock fast-forwards ('三個小時後…') to 20:00 and plays a 10–15 s authored scene of the festival as the story left it: taped-off stage and the performance moved to the plaza; officers standing at the stall; a dark shuttered flower shop; people reading 小雯's exposé on their phones; vendors with signs; lanterns rising. Then the challenge stamps land.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point end-of-year awards; The Sims / RimWorld epilogue; Goose Game's final bell
proposals.implementation: Evidence: 0/38 stories reach 20:00. Cap-ended stories stop at a median of 16:42 (16:11–18:58), quiet ones between 15:20 and 18:42, so the festival setup never pays off. director.ts: after status done (where GameUI.tsx L440-444 waits 4.2 s), queue a deterministic 'epilogue' step that reads run.world only (stage, police, shops, articles, gatherings, statements, festival) and places the existing props/poses (Crowd.tsx acts, StreetProps). Caption it '20:00 燈籠節（依照故事結束時的世界）'. No model calls; nothing shown that the log doesn't contain, e.g. no stage collapse, since none is logged.
proposals.risk: It must not look like Gemma output or imply new events; caption it as a summary. It adds a little playback length; make it skippable.

cut: Results header 4-stat grid (影響居民 / 傳播層數 / 世界變化 / 燈籠節) in GameUI.tsx L272-284: '燈籠節' showed 照常 in 38/38 runs and 傳播層數 is an engineering metric. Replace it with the headline and challenge stamps.
The numeric 'What If 比較' block (reach / depth / world numbers, GameUI.tsx L288-298): replace it with 'last time: {headline} / this time: {headline}'.
The mayor's power chip '🏮 有權取消燈籠節' (PlaybackLayer.tsx L20) as the only promise: no Gemma run in lab/runs ever cancelled or made a statement. Change it once statements are reachable, or drop it.

Organizer 志明's post_notice action: 0 uses in 38 runs (志明's actions are only phone 42 / tell 26 / none 11). The plaza notice board never gets a notice; drop it from his menu to shorten the prompt, or repurpose it.
The '傳到：…；最後做出判斷的是X' line in Results (GameUI.tsx L285-287): it repeats the story card.
Player-facing '完整事件因果鏈' list and '🔬 技術紀錄' in Results: move them behind one small 'see the proof' link for judges, not the default view.
The 'simulating' panel counters ('已完成 N 個居民判斷 · N 次模型呼叫 · N 秒', GameUI.tsx L612-621): tool-like; streaming playback starts at the first event anyway.
Seven equal-weight 'What If 告訴X' buttons: show 2 recommended listeners plus a collapsed '其他人'.

阿德's first example chip '聽說市長很害怕鴿子。' (scenario.ts PUBLIC_BIO): it fizzled within 2–3 people in 5/5 runs, so as the very first suggestion it teaches new players that the game fizzles. Move it into the 🗣️ gossip challenge hint, where it sets up the whisper, and lead with a sentence that usually lands.
